title: Garden of Tears
description: A surreal dark scene features a fragmented woman in the foreground with red and blue dripping tears, her hand near her open mouth. In the midground, a stone path leads to a floating blue platform with a white horse, a cloaked figure pushing a shopping cart labeled 'PAUSED', and a building labeled 'GARDEN' suspended in a net above, all under a giant weeping female face with multiple eyes against a black background with red and blue dripping paint.
prompt: Surreal dark artwork with a fragmented crying woman in foreground with red and blue dripping tears, hand touching her mouth, stone path with red poppies leading to a glowing blue platform holding a white horse and a cloaked figure pushing a red shopping cart that says PAUSED, above them a building trapped in a net labeled GARDEN, giant weeping female face with multiple eyes dripping red and blue liquid from the top, black background, high contrast, symbolic and unsettling atmosphere.
